art.medium: album leaf from a set; ink and color on silk

This album leaf depicts the 8th-century Chinese official and Daoist scholar Zhang Zhihe sitting on a raft buffeted by waves. He drinks wine from a small cup, and gazes up at a crane flying above him.

items.excerpt: Machinist. Emma Stebbins (American, 1815–1882). c. 1859. Marble. Stebbins belonged to a community of women sculptors in Rome. Like their male colleagues, they sought to emulate the statues of antiquity. In a rare pair of marble statues, Stebbins portrays a machinist and his apprentice, an unusual theme in mid-19th-century American sculpture.

items.title: Despair
items.summary: La poesia 'Despair' esplora il tema del dolore profondo e dell'isolamento, descrivendo un individuo sopraffatto dalla tristezza che evita ogni contatto sociale. Il poeta analizza la natura persistente della disperazione e l’impossibilità di trovare conforto.
items.excerpt:
Ask not the pallid stranger's woe,
With beating heart and throbbing breast,
Whose step is faltering, weak, and slow,
As though the body needed rest.--
Whose 'wildered eye no object meets,
Nor cares to ken a friendly glance,
With silent grief his bosom beats,--
Now fixed, as in a deathlike trance.
Who looks around with fearful eye,
And shuns all converse with man kind,

items.title: En Israël, Gadi Eisenkot dénonce les ruses de Benyamin Nétanyahou, qui plaide pour la formation d’un gouvernement d’union

Une position fustigée par le gouvernement et les candidats d’un arc allant de la social-démocratie à la droite. Samedi soir, le chef de l’Etat a mis en garde contre le risque d’une « vulnérabilisation durable » de l’Europe.

quiz.q: Quale è l'azione che Macron denuncia in relazione all'Ucraina?

Un critico e romanziere ha utilizzato il dipinto per esplorare le vite intrecciate dell'artista e della musa, offrendo uno spaccato di Los Angeles negli anni '60.

items.excerpt: In the summer of 1966, David Hockney began work on one of his most iconic paintings: “ Beverly Hills Housewife ,” a portrait of the arts patron Betty Freeman. She is depicted on her garden patio in front of her sleek, modernist house, which is framed by strips of blue sky and green lawn.

items.title: Popular cannabis supplement shows inconsistent anti-inflammatory effects in brain cells
items.summary: Una nuova ricerca laboratoriale pubblicata su Toxicology rivela che gli effetti del cannabigerolo, un composto non psicoattivo della pianta di cannabis, sulle cellule immunitarie cerebrali sono inconsistenti e dipendono fortemente dalla concentrazione. Bassi dosaggi hanno mantenuto le cellule intatte, mentre ad alte dosaggi si è verificato il danneggiamento delle cellule e lo stress chimico.
items.titleIt: Supplemento a base di cannabis mostra effetti antinfiammatori incoerenti nelle cellule cerebrali
items.excerpt: Cannabigerol, a non-intoxicating compound from the cannabis plant, has gained popularity as a dietary supplement for its purported anti-inflammatory and brain-protecting properties. However, new laboratory research published in Toxicology suggests that its effects on brain immune cells are inconsistent and heavily dependent on concentration.

quiz.q: Quale fattore principale influenza gli effetti del cannabigerolo sulle cellule cerebrali?
options: La quantità di luce a cui sono esposte le cellule.
Il colore della pianta di cannabis.
